name: How much does doorway widening for accessibility usually cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does doorway widening for accessibility usually cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends mostly on whether the wall is load-bearing, how much finish repair is needed, and whether you are changing the door hardware or swing. Homeowners often budget more if the project is part of a larger accessibility remodel, because the setup and finish work can be shared across multiple improvements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Price varies based on wall structure, finish repairs, and any permit or inspection work. It is usually more affordable when done alongside other remodeling rather than as a standalone emergency fix.
